headline: Get Bouldus
title: How to Get Bouldus | Baleetle Rock Branch | Aniimo Guide
video_script: Baleetle evolves at level thirty nine, and it has two branches. Waleetle needs nothing extra. For Bouldus, your Baleetle must learn the passive talent Peculiar Rock Ball before it evolves. Bouldus is the last stage of the line, and in the wild it lives in Berylline Vale. Waleetle or Bouldus? Comment below!
description: Baleetle evolves at level 39 into Waleetle, or into Bouldus if it learned the passive talent Peculiar Rock Ball.
